title: Strip and Body Cavity Searches
citation: N.J.S.A. 2A:161A-1 et seq.; AG strip search guidelines
key_points: A person detained or arrested for a non-indictable offense may not be strip searched unless there is a warrant or consent, or a statutory exception applies (such as reasonable suspicion of a weapon, CDS or evidence, with supervisory authorization).
Body cavity searches require a search warrant and must be done by medical personnel.
Searches must be done in private by officers of the same sex, and documented.
officer_notes: Confirm the exact exceptions and authorization rules in your agency's policy before any strip search.
